prs.title: fix(shared): make McpError and UrlElicitationRequiredError pickle-safe on v1.x
prs.author: NishchayMahor
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Python's default Exception.__reduce_ex__ reconstructs exceptions via cls(*self.args). All three PRs fix this by overriding __reduce__ to return the correct reconstruction arguments. (3 PRs)

members.author: gyang-xai
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2607: Errors in the StreamableHTTP client are silently swallowed instead of being converted to JSONRPC error responses, causing the caller to hang indefinitely. members.title: fix(shared): preserve MCPError payload on pickle
members.author: MukundaKatta
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2703: Python's default Exception.__reduce_ex__ reconstructs exceptions via cls(*self.args). Because MCPError.__init__(error: ErrorData) calls super().__init__(error.message), self.args holds only a plain string, so unpickling calls MCPError(message_str) and crashes. UrlElicitationRequiredError compounds this with a mismatched constructor signature (elicitations, message=None). All three PRs fix this by overriding __reduce__ to return the correct reconstruction arguments.

members.title: fix(shared): preserve MCPError payload on pickle
members.author: MukundaKatta
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2703: Python's default Exception.__reduce_ex__ reconstructs exceptions via cls(*self.args). Because MCPError.__init__(error: ErrorData) calls super().__init__(error.message), self.args holds only a plain string, so unpickling calls MCPError(message_str) and crashes. UrlElicitationRequiredError compounds this with a mismatched constructor signature (elicitations, message=None). All three PRs fix this by overriding __reduce__ to return the correct reconstruction arguments.
